title: Multi-Domain Cyber & Intel Operations Center, Lackland Air Force Base, Texas
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Fort Worth District, on behalf of the Department of the Air Force (DAF), is issuing this solicitation announcement to identify a Design-Build (DB) team for a new Multi-Domain Cyber & Intel Operations Center (MDCIOC) at Joint Base San Antonio (JBSA), Lackland AFB, Texas. The proposed project involves the design and construction of an approximately 600,000-square-foot, multi-story facility to consolidate the 16th Air Force's Information Warfare workforce. The new center will be a state-of-the-art, 24/7 facility designed to the highest security and technical standards, including ICD 705. The project will house over 3,000 personnel and support global cyberspace operations, intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR). The project delivery model will be a Progressive Design-Build (PDB) executed through an Other Transaction (OT) Agreement. The acquisition will be conducted in two phases: Phase 1: Design and Pre-Construction Services: The selected DB team will collaborate with the Government to advance the design and refine project requirements. Phase 2: Full Design and Construction: Upon successful negotiation of a fair and reasonable price, the OT may be modified to include the final design and construction. The Government will use a two-step, qualifications-based selection process: White Paper Submission & Evaluation. Pitch Meetings (by invitation only). Request for White Papers: Interested parties are invited to submit a White Paper in accordance with this announcement and its attachments. The White Paper is the only submission required at this time and must address all requirements outlined in Attachment 1 of the solicitation to be considered. Submissions should demonstrate the respondent's qualifications, project understanding, and relevant experience. Questions Due Date: All questions must be submitted via the ProjNet Bidder Inquiry System by September 18, 2026, in accordance with the instructions in the solicitation. White Paper Due Date: White Papers must be submitted via email to the Solicitation POCs no later than 2:00 PM CT on September 25, 2026. Email Subject Line: "White Paper for Multi Domain Cyber & Intel Operations Center" Please refer to the attached solicitation document and Attachments for complete details on the project scope, submission requirements, and evaluation criteria.

description: Opportunities Description The Department of Veterans Affairs currently occupies office and related space in a building under a lease in Gainesville, Florida, which will be expiring. title: Perforated Window Film
description: This contract is in support of the United States Marine Corps Recruiting Command (MCRC) Branding Program for each of the six (6) Marine Corps Districts (MCD), which are located throughout the United States, overseas and its territories. The use of branded locations, emphasizing the approved Marine Corps colors, symbols, themes, furnishings, and lighting effects will help distinguish Marine Corps recruiting offices from recruiting offices of other Armed Services, providing a distinct recruiting advantage vis-a-vis other Services. The appearance of the branded offices leaves a positive impression not just with prospects, but their parents and other influencers as well. MCRC is taking steps to improve physical security of recruiting facilities. MCRC intends to utilize perforated window film on the glass surfaces of storefront recruiting facilities in order to provide concealment, more specifically, protection from observation. It is necessary to have a means of obscuring the view of Marine recruiting station from the outside as a force protection measure. It is also necessary that, where practical, the Marines maintain visibility of the area outside of their office in order to maintain their situational awareness. This will provide them with the possibility of early warning, if a potential aggressor is approaching the office or preparing to commit some type of hostile or unlawful act, outside the office. Perforated window film will allow for MCRC Branding Program success, while providing increased security for recruiting personnel and individuals visiting recruiting offices. As a part of this requirement, the current storefront glass graphics will be removed, and new perforated window film will be installed to span the entire glass window/door surface. Perforated window film will be installed on existing facilities that have no storefront graphics. Additionally, perforated film will be replaced on existing facilities as required.

description: This requirement is for 60-ton Grove crane repair services for the 819th Red Horse Squadron (RHS) at Malmstrom Air Force Base. Contractor must meet OEM specifications as identified in Technical Order 36-1-191. This asset currently has a hydraulic leak that requires major drive-train disassembly and replacement of a 5 port hydraulic swivel manifold assembly. Also, several other items (wire rope, o-rings, fill cap with breather, element, lock pin, seal kit, slip ring assembly) need to be replaced in order for the crane to be certified as fully functional. Due to the hydraulic leak, the asset can not be driven and therefor needs to be transported to the maintenance shop where it will be repaired. There is currently no trailer in inventory large enough to move the 60-ton crane. This requirement will be solicited as a sole-source action to MGX Equipement Services as they are the only known authorized dealer in the state of Montana that has the capabilities to perform the complex repairs. The contractor shall perform all tasks in accordance with the saliant characteristics document and comply with all applicable local, state, and federal regulations.

title: Pulsed Laser Cleaner
description: COMBINED SYNOPSIS/SOLICITATION FOR COMMERCIAL PRODUCTS AND COMMERCIAL SERVICES General Information Document Type: Combined Synopsis/Solicitation Solicitation Number: 9531BM26Q0029 Product or Service Code: 6640 � Laboratory Equipment and Supplies Set Aside: 100% Small Business Set-Aside NAICS Code: 333517 � Machine Tool Manufacturing Small Business Size Standard: 500 employees Contract Type: Firm-Fixed-Price (FPP) Purchase Order FOB Point: Destination Quotation Due Date: September 24, 2026, 4:00 p.m., Eastern Daylight Time (EDT) Contracting Office Address: National Transportation Safety Board Acquisition Division (CFO-30) 490 L�Enfant Plaza, SW Washington, DC 20594 Combined Synopsis/Solicitation This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in Subpart 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes only solicitation; quotations are being requested and a written solicitation will not be issued. The solicitation number for this requirement is 9531BM26Q0029. This solicitation is issued as a Request for Quotations (RFQ). The solicitation document and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular (FAC) 2026-01. The requirement is issued as a 100% total small business set-aside. The associated North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code for this procurement is NAICS code is 333517, �Machine Tool Manufacturing�. The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) requires the purchase and delivery of one (1) pulsed laser cleaning machine, SFX Laser BPC-500, or equal. The named product establishes the characteristics and level of quality that will satisfy the Government�s requirement. Equal products will be considered in accordance with FAR 52.211-6, Brand Name or Equal. The equipment shall be new and current production. Used, refurbished, remanufactured, demonstration, or protype equipment will not be accepted. Background The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) is an independent Federal agency charged by Congress with investigating every civil aviation accident in the United States and significant accidents in the other modes of transportation -- railroad, transit, highway, marine, pipeline, and commercial space-- and issuing safety recommendations aimed at preventing future accidents. The NTSB has a requirement to purchase one (1) pulsed laser cleaning machine. This equipment will aid in the removal of rust, contaminants, coatings, and paint from portions of accident wreckage and components so that examination and testing can be performed. This type of evidence surface preparation has traditionally been done by contracting a third-party vendor for sandblasting. Laser cleaning is less damaging to the underlying material than abrasive sandblasting or chemical methods of surface contaminant removal and will better preserve the condition and features of the evidence under examination. Laser cleaning will also reduce the amount of hazardous material waste generated by sandblasting and chemical methods of surface preparation. Products The contractor shall provide firm-fixed pricing for the item listed below. The quotation shall include all costs necessary to provide the required equipment, operation manuals, one-year warranty, and FOB Destination delivery in accordance with this RFQ. CLIN 001: Description: Pulsed Laser Cleaner, Qty:1, Unit: EA, Unit Price: $_______, Extended Price: $_______ TOTAL QUOTED PRICE: $__________ Minimum Salient Characteristics The pulsed laser cleaning machine, shall meet the following minimum specifications: The laser cleaner shall be of the pulsed laser variety. The laser cleaner shall be capable of operating on 208V single phase power. The laser cleaner shall have a minimum of 500W output power. The laser cleaner shall have adjustable pulse width and frequency. The laser cleaner shall have multiple cleaning mode patterns. The laser cleaner shall have anti-reflection protection. The laser cleaner shall have a sturdy chassis with storage for the cables and laser head. The laser cleaner be furnished with Operation Manuals. The laser cleaner shall have a warranty against defects in materials and workmanship for a period of one (1) year from delivery date. The quotation shall clearly identify the manufacturer and exact model offered and shall include manufacturer technical literature sufficient to verify compliance with each minimum salient characteristic. Review the attached RFQ document and attachments which are attached hereto and incorporated herein for a detailed description of the requirement. Brand Name or Equal FAR 52.211-6, Brand Name or Equal, applies to this acquisition. A quoter offering the referenced SFX Laser BPC-500 shall identify the manufacturer and exact model offered. A quoter offering an equal product shall clearly identify the manufacturer and model number and furnish descriptive literature sufficient to establish that the proposed product meets or exceeds each minimum salient characteristic. For an equal product, the quotation shall include a concise compliance cross-reference identifying each salient characteristic, the offered specification, and the technical-literature page or section supporting compliance. Any modification required to make the offered product conform to the requirements shall be clearly identified. The Government will evaluate an equal product based on information furnished with the quotation or specifically identified in the quotation and reasonably available to the Contracting Officer. The Government is not responsible for locating technical information that the quoter has not identified. Delivery The offeror shall deliver the laser cleaner and all necessary operational manuals within 60 calendar days of the date of award. The equipment is to be delivered FOB Destination to: National Transportation Safety Board Office of Research and Engineering 401 Prince Georges Blvd Upper Marlboro, MD 20774 Basis for Award The Government intends to award one (1) firm-fixed-price contract to the responsible Contractor whose quotation conforms to the requirements of this RFQ and represents the lowest-priced technically acceptable quotation. The Government will evaluate quotations using the following factors: Technical Acceptability Price Factor 1: Technical Acceptability Technical Acceptability will be evaluated on an Acceptable/Unacceptable basis. To be determined technically acceptable, the quotation must offer a new pulsed laser cleaner that meets each minimum salient characteristic and other material requirement of this RFQ; provide sufficient technical information to verify compliance; meet the required delivery schedule; and take no exception to a material requirement. A quotation that does not demonstrate compliance with each minimum salient characteristic and other material requirement will be determined technically unacceptable and will not be considered for award. Features or capabilities exceeding the stated minimum requirements will not receive additional evaluation credit. Factor 2: Price The Government will evaluate the total firm-fixed price for the requirement and will evaluate price for reasonableness using appropriate price analysis techniques. Evaluation Factor Order of Importance Technical Acceptability is a threshold requirement. Among quotations determined technically acceptable, award will be made to the responsible quoter submitting the lowest total evaluated price. No tradeoffs will be made between price and non-price factors. Clauses and Provisions Please review and complete Attachment 1 and Clauses and Provisions, where applicable. The attachment is included hereto and incorporated herein for additional information..
